observations: Line 1 declares `bucket=[]` as a default argument, which is evaluated once at function definition time rather than per call.
Lines 2-3 append to and return the same default list object across calls, so omitted-bucket calls share state rather than receiving a fresh bucket.
The stated behavior contract ('Each omitted-bucket call gets a fresh bucket') is not satisfied by the implementation at lines 1-3.
Probe p1 (collect(1) then collect(2) with omitted bucket) would return snapshots of the same mutated list, not two independent buckets.
Probe p2 (collect(3, [9])) passes an explicit list, which is mutated in place at line 2 and returned at line 3, matching the explicit-bucket part of the contract.
No exception handling or input validation is present; non-list explicit buckets would raise at line 2's append.
